item.title: Sign suggestion, 4th August
item.description:
Approaching the dual carriageway from coombe hill leading to Tewkesbury. A suggestion of a NO ENTRY sign to deter people from overtaking too early & better distinguish the road layout. On several occasions I have witnessed drivers overtake early approaching the dual carriageway and enter the wrong side of the carriageway, swerving to correct side of the road. On one occasion a driver had to reverse when they realised their error. Fortunately no oncoming cars otherwise could have been a nasty crash.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Tewkesbury Road, Leigh, Tewkesbury
Report on FixMyStreet
